device_name: ELEVATE Spinal System, CAPSTONE PTC Spinal System, CRESCENT Spinal System, CRESCENT Spinal System Titanium
device_name_fda: ELEVATE Spinal System, CAPSTONE PTC Spinal System, CRESCENT Spinal System, CRESCENT Spinal System Titanium
what_it_is:
The CAPSTONE PTC is the PEEK spacer that has been coated with pure titanium to increase surface area and grip on bone surface. Capstone PTC by Medtronic is intended for use either unilaterally  obliquely or bilaterally in the PLIF procedure for interbody stabilization. It features a 10mm width spacer anatomically designed for easier implantation and contour to the endplate.

Features:
- Radiolucent PTC design with teeth on surface to prevent expulsion
- Surface coated titanium
- Can be placed MIS using MIS inserters
- Tantalum marker on cage
- Anatomic convex shape
- Footprint options:
- 10x22mm
- 10x26mm
- 10x32mm
- 10x36mm
- Height options: 6-16mm
